strings.scene.xia.qi.title: 家天下
strings.scene.xia.qi.subtitle: 启继禹位
strings.vo.01: 禹东巡至会稽而崩，把天下交给了益。
strings.vo.02: 三年之丧毕，益让位给禹的儿子启，自己避居箕山之南。
strings.vo.03: 诸侯不去朝益，而去朝启，说：这是我们的君主、帝禹之子。
strings.vo.04: 启即天子位。有扈氏不服，启发兵讨之，大战于甘。
strings.scene.xia.qi.quote: 用命，赏于祖；弗用命，戮于社。
strings.scene.xia.qi.fork.prompt: 家天下——依《史记》直书，还是听异说「益干启位」？
strings.anchor.yu-beng: 禹崩于会稽，以天下授益
strings.scene.xia.qi.pick.canon: 正史 · 《史记·夏本纪》《尚书·甘誓》所载
strings.scene.xia.qi.canon.intro: 禅让到了这里改了样子。益让了，诸侯也选了。可有扈氏不认这个选择。
strings.scene.xia.qi.end.canon: 有扈氏灭，天下咸朝。自此天子之位父子相传，史称“家天下”。
strings.scene.xia.qi.legend.disclaimer: 以下取自古本《竹书纪年》佚文与《楚辞·天问》，与《史记》“益让”之说相反，属异说。
strings.scene.xia.qi.legend.intro: 汲冢出土的《竹书纪年》说：益干启位，启杀之。没有礼让，只有一场争夺。
strings.scene.xia.qi.end.legend: 益死，启立。竹书与《史记》经过相反，结果却同为启即天子位，汇流回甘之战之后。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：咖啡色、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

strings.scene.xia.shaokang.title: 少康中兴
strings.scene.xia.shaokang.subtitle: 有穷之乱
strings.vo.01: 夏启之后，太康失国。有穷氏后羿因夏民而代夏政。
strings.vo.02: 后羿恃其善射，不修民事；其相寒浞杀之，据其室，又使子浇灭夏后相。
strings.vo.03: 相之妻后缗方有身孕，自墙洞逃出，归于母家有仍。
strings.vo.04: 遗腹之子少康长大，先为牧正，后奔有虞，有田一成，有众一旅。
strings.vo.05: 他派女艾潜入浇的营中——
strings.scene.xia.shaokang.fork.prompt: 少康中兴——依《左传》直书，还是听野史「射日之羿」？
strings.scene.xia.shaokang.canon.intro: 少康手里只有方十里的田、五百人的众。他不能硬拼，先要弄清浇的营里谁在守夜。
strings.scene.xia.shaokang.end.canon: 浇与豷相继覆灭，少康复禹之绩，夏祀不绝。
strings.scene.xia.shaokang.legend.disclaimer: 以下为神话。神话中射日的羿与有穷氏后羿是否一人，古来混说，史家多以为非一人。
strings.scene.xia.shaokang.legend.intro: 神话说：尧时十日并出，草木焦枯，羿上射十日，下除猛兽。后世常把这位羿与篡夏的后羿混为一谈。
strings.scene.xia.shaokang.end.legend: 射日的英雄与篡夏的国君，在后世笔下叠成一人。画卷合上，回到少康复国。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：咖啡色、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

strings.scene.xia.kongjia.title: 御龙氏
strings.scene.xia.kongjia.subtitle: 孔甲
strings.vo.01: 孔甲即位的时候，夏朝已经衰落，诸侯渐渐离心。
strings.vo.02: 他喜好鬼神。《夏本纪》说，天降下两条龙，一雌一雄，孔甲却找不到会养龙的人。
strings.vo.03: 陶唐氏的后人刘累，学过驯龙的本事，前来侍奉孔甲。孔甲赐他姓御龙氏。
strings.vo.04: 后来雌龙死了。刘累不敢声张，把龙肉做成肉酱，献给了孔甲。
strings.vo.05: 孔甲吃完，又派人来要龙——
strings.scene.xia.kongjia.fork.prompt: 御龙氏——依《史记》直书，还是听野史「萯山破斧之歌」？
strings.scene.xia.kongjia.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《史记·夏本纪》《左传·昭公二十九年》所载
strings.scene.xia.kongjia.canon.intro: 龙出现在正史里，听起来像神话。太史公照着《左传》的旧说写了下来，用它说明一件事：夏德已衰。
strings.scene.xia.kongjia.end.canon: 刘累惧而迁去，到了鲁县。《夏本纪》接着写道：孔甲崩，子帝皋立；三传至桀，夏亡。
strings.scene.xia.kongjia.pick.legend: 野史 · 萯山破斧之歌
strings.scene.xia.kongjia.legend.disclaimer: 以下取《吕氏春秋·音初》：孔甲田猎于东阳萯山，遇大风入民家，所收养的孩子后来因斧伤足，孔甲作《破斧之歌》，是为“东音”之始。这是战国秦汉间的传说。
strings.scene.xia.kongjia.legend.intro: 东阳萯山，大风骤起，天昏地暗。孔甲迷了路，走进了一户正在生孩子的人家。
strings.scene.xia.kongjia.end.legend: 一个说孔甲贪龙，一个说孔甲作歌。两种传说都发生在夏德衰落之时。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：咖啡色、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

narration: 孔甲即位的时候，夏朝已经衰落，诸侯渐渐离心。
他喜好鬼神。《夏本纪》说，天降下两条龙，一雌一雄，孔甲却找不到会养龙的人。
陶唐氏的后人刘累，学过驯龙的本事，前来侍奉孔甲。孔甲赐他姓御龙氏。
后来雌龙死了。刘累不敢声张，把龙肉做成肉酱，献给了孔甲。
孔甲吃完，又派人来要龙——
刘累惧而迁去，到了鲁县。《夏本纪》接着写道：孔甲崩，子帝皋立；三传至桀，夏亡。
孔甲赐之姓曰御龙氏。

strings.scene.xia.meixi.title: 有施之女
strings.scene.xia.meixi.subtitle: 妹喜
strings.vo.01: 夏的最后一个王叫桀。《史记》说他不修德行，用武力伤害百姓，百姓不堪忍受。
strings.vo.02: 晋国的史苏后来讲过：桀攻打有施氏，有施人把一个叫妹喜的女子献给了他。
strings.vo.03: 妹喜得宠。可古本《竹书纪年》又说，桀后来攻打岷山，得到了琬、琰二女，就把妹喜丢在了洛水边。
strings.vo.04: 被冷落的妹喜，据说与远方商国来的伊尹有了往来。
strings.scene.xia.meixi.fork.prompt: 有施之女——依《国语》直书，还是听野史「酒池与裂缯」？
strings.scene.xia.meixi.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《国语·晋语一》《史记·夏本纪》所载
strings.scene.xia.meixi.canon.intro: 在《国语》里，妹喜是一则讲给国君听的警告：女色亡国。这一段先照原书讲，再在史评里把这种说法摆上来看。
strings.scene.xia.meixi.end.canon: 史苏对晋献公说：夏桀伐有施，得妹喜，妹喜与伊尹比而亡夏。献公没有听，后来骊姬之乱几乎亡晋。
strings.scene.xia.meixi.legend.disclaimer: 以下取西汉刘向《列女传·孽嬖传·夏桀末喜》“为酒池可以运舟”，以及皇甫谧《帝王世纪》“末喜好闻裂缯之声而笑”（《太平御览》卷一百三十五引）。这些是汉晋人的渲染，把亡国之罪归于女子，史评另有讨论。
strings.scene.xia.meixi.legend.intro: 宫中挖了一个大池，盛满了酒，池上可以行船。鼓声一响，三千人俯身像牛一样饮酒。
strings.scene.xia.meixi.end.legend: 酒池的故事越传越长，妹喜的面目越来越模糊。夏还是亡了，亡在桀自己手里。

style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

narration: 夏的最后一个王叫桀。《史记》说他不修德行，用武力伤害百姓，百姓不堪忍受。
晋国的史苏后来讲过：桀攻打有施氏，有施人把一个叫妹喜的女子献给了他。
妹喜得宠。可古本《竹书纪年》又说，桀后来攻打岷山，得到了琬、琰二女，就把妹喜丢在了洛水边。
被冷落的妹喜，据说与远方商国来的伊尹有了往来。
小船离开了岸——
史苏对晋献公说：夏桀伐有施，得妹喜，妹喜与伊尹比而亡夏。献公没有听，后来骊姬之乱几乎亡晋。

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 60 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Xia dynasty (c. 2070–1600 BCE), c. 1630 BCE — rammed-earth platforms and palaces, pottery, turquoise inlay, Yellow River plains.

Characters:
- Jie (桀) — ruler, Xia; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence
- Mo Xi (妹喜) — royal / consort, Youshi; hemp cross-collar tunics, early bronze ornaments; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments
- Wan and Yan (琬、琰) — royal / consort, Minshan; hemp cross-collar tunics, early bronze ornaments; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments
- Yi Yin (伊尹) — minister, Shang; hemp cross-collar tunics, early bronze ornaments; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents
- Shi Su (史苏) — scholar, Jin; hemp cross-collar tunics, early bronze ornaments; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground; subject: cavalry | Action: Xia chariots roll into the valleys of Youshi | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; ink spatters where hooves strike; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「有施之女」 with vermilion seal 「有施」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「夏的最后一个王叫桀。《史记》说他不修德行，用武力伤害百姓，百姓不堪忍受。」
Shot 2 (10–19 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: gate; subject: Mo Xi, crowd | Action: The Youshi people present a young woman to end the war | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「晋国的史苏后来讲过：桀攻打有施氏，有施人把一个叫妹喜的女子献给了他。」
Shot 3 (19–30 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Jie, fire (splashed ink) | Action: Palace lanterns and endless music | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; heavy ink pillars giving depth; splashed ink flames tipped with vermilion; heat-haze and smoke distortion | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: drum | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「妹喜得宠。可古本《竹书纪年》又说，桀后来攻打岷山，得到了琬、琰二女，就把妹喜丢在了洛水边。」
Shot 4 (30–37 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Wan and Yan, cavalry, banners | Action: Jie attacks Minshan and brings back two more women | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; ink spatters where hooves strike; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「被冷落的妹喜，据说与远方商国来的伊尹有了往来。」
Shot 5 (37–43 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: river, boat; subject: Mo Xi; dry-brush calligraphy 「洛」 | Action: By the Luo River a woman boards a small boat alone | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; vignette closing in from the corners; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「小船离开了岸——」
Shot 6 (43–54 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Mo Xi | Action: Canonical outcome: Shi Su warns Duke Xian of Jin with the tale of Meixi; the duke ignores him and Jin nearly falls to the Liji crisis. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「史苏对晋献公说：夏桀伐有施，得妹喜，妹喜与伊尹比而亡夏。献公没有听，后来骊姬之乱几乎亡晋。」

strings.scene.xia.mingtiao.title: 鸣条
strings.scene.xia.mingtiao.subtitle: 商汤灭夏
strings.vo.01: 夏桀之时，诸侯多叛。商汤居亳，修德而众归之。
strings.vo.02: 伊尹相汤，伐葛伯、昆吾，夏之羽翼渐去。
strings.vo.03: 汤作誓，告其众曰：夏之罪多，天命殛之。
strings.vo.04: 汤率诸侯伐桀，桀败于有娀之虚，奔于鸣条。
strings.scene.xia.mingtiao.fork.prompt: 鸣条——依《史记》直书，还是听异说「伊尹间夏」？
strings.scene.xia.mingtiao.canon.intro: 汤先伐葛伯、昆吾，剪掉夏的羽翼；如今要对众人说清，为什么非伐夏不可。
strings.scene.xia.mingtiao.end.canon: 桀走鸣条，遂被放逐而死（《尚书》序称放于南巢）。汤即天子位，商代夏。
strings.scene.xia.mingtiao.legend.disclaimer: 以下取自《国语》《吕氏春秋》等书的说法，与《史记》叙述不同，史家多存疑。
strings.scene.xia.mingtiao.legend.intro: 《国语》说妺喜得宠，“与伊尹比而亡夏”；《吕氏春秋》又说伊尹曾奔夏三年，探听夏宫之事。
strings.scene.xia.mingtiao.end.legend: 伊尹回亳，汤遂出兵。异说的终点仍是鸣条之战。
